test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: On compound interest, a certain sum becomes Rs. 19,360 after 2 years and Rs. 21,296 after 3 years. Find the simple interest on the same sum at the same rate of interest for 3 years.
solution:
**Given:**

A sum becomes Rs. 19360 in 2 years and Rs. 21296 in 3 years

**Concept used:**

A = P(1 + r/100)t

S. I = Ptr/100

Here,

P = principal

t = time

r = rate

A = amount

**Calculation:**

Let the sum be Rs. P and the rate be r

According to the question,

19360 = P(1 + r/100)² ----(i)

21296 = P(1 + r/100)3 ----(ii)

By dividing eq (i) from eq (ii) we get,

(21296)/(19360)=(P(1 + frac{r)/(100))³}{P(1 + (r)/(100))²}

⇒ (11)/(10)=(1 + (r)/(100))

⇒ (11)/(10)=((100 + r)/(100))

⇒ 1100 = 1000 + 10r

⇒ 10r = 100

⇒ r = 100/10

⇒ r = 10

So, rate = 10%

Now putting the value of r in the eq (i) we get,

19360 = P(1 + 10/100)²

⇒ 19360 = P(1 + 1/10)²

⇒ 19360 = P(11/10)2

⇒ 19360 = 121P/100

⇒ P = 19360 × (100/121)

⇒ P = 16000

So, sum = Rs. 16000

Now,

S. I = (16000 × 3 × 10)/100

⇒ S. I = 160 × 3 × 10

⇒ S. I = 4800

So, simple interest = Rs. 4800

**∴ The simple interest on the same sum at the same rate of interest for 3 years is Rs. 4800.**
